propositions: Pass-1 re-reviews during execution flag plan-directed work as discrepancies when the work has already been completed, creating false positives that block ticket closure
A Pass-2 veto controlled by execution_review flag and current_state_satisfies_plan_goal answer must drop findings only when the code's present state already satisfies the plan's directed end state
The veto is cohort-restricted to CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) and enforced deterministically in the orchestrator by forcing non-grounded findings' answers to na before delegating to the kernel
The new current_state_satisfies_plan_goal sub-answer is na-default, plan-review-only, and excluded from GRADED_BINARY validity arithmetic
The execution_review phase signal must flow from orchestrator.pass3_over_findings through the kernel as a keyword argument, defaulting False so planning reviews remain unaffected
